Definitional (sensitivity point / trade-off point as the lesson defines them for itself, matching outline items 1-2). No official doc root for this term in versions.yaml; the lesson does not attribute the definitions to any named method.

Follows from claims 1-2 and the code: concurrency limiter "limits the number of concurrent requests" (rate-limit.md l.276); with Redis down each running product read queries PostgreSQL (Program.cs l.145-146) through a pool capped at 100 by default. issues.quote: the field that names which user the token was issued for
issues.text: New in round 2. RFC 7519 §4.1.2 defines sub as identifying "the principal that is the subject of the JWT". An OAuth access token is issued to a client; "issued for" blurs subject with client/audience (claim 13 rephrased).
issues.fix: Write: "counted by the `sub` of the access token, the field that names the user the token is about." Update claim 13 text to match.
